info.title: Infrawrench API
info.description: REST API for the Infrawrench cloud SaaS. Plugin and resource type IDs are enumerated from the live plugin registry at spec-build time, so this document always matches what the running server actually accepts.

tags.name: Resources
tags.description: CRUD, manifest, logs, secrets, metrics — all dispatched to plugins.

tags.name: Connections
tags.description: SQL / KV / Docker / SFTP / Storage operations against live resources.

tags.description: Helpers for shipping credentials into other services.

tags.name: Storage
tags.description: Object storage helpers (uploads via API key).

tags.name: SSH keys
tags.description: Org SSH keys for tunnel/SSH access.

tags.name: WebSocket
tags.description: Auth tokens for the WebSocket gateway.

tags.name: Sync
tags.description: Bi-directional resource sync (used by the desktop app).

sessionCookie.name: wos-session
sessionCookie.description: WorkOS-issued sealed session cookie (httpOnly, set by `/callback`). Used by browser clients.

bearerAuth.description: WorkOS access token (JWT) or Infrawrench API key. Used by programmatic clients.

PluginId.description: Manifest id of an installed plugin.

JsonObject.description: Free-form JSON object whose shape depends on the plugin.

ResourceTypeId.description: Resource type id. Note: not every plugin exposes every type — see the plugin's `resourceTypes` for the valid (pluginId, typeId) pairs.

ResourceStatus.description: Normalized status reported by a plugin's renderSidebarItem/renderDetail.

privateKey.description: Returned once. Not persisted in plaintext.

Permission.description: A permission string. Roles may grant exact permissions like the entries in this enum, or wildcards (e.g. `resources:*:read`, `*`).
